description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 18.04.2016 - 24.04.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how foreign currency transactions will be calculated for customs purposes. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
